correctness.rationale: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/audit_betti.py from scratch: h4-distribution {0:1752,1:2124,2:468,3:24} over C(16,5)=4368, 10 distinct tables with frequencies 684/348/336/120/108/60/36/24/24/12 summing to 1752, dual-prime (32003 vs 1000003) agreement on all 1752, Euler identity vs (1+4t+10t^2+5t^3)(1-t)^4 holds for every ideal, exact rational agreement on all 80 S4-orbit representatives (66x24+14x12=1752), Borel-fixed scan 0/1752 over all 24 orders, full-stratum C(20,5)=15504 with 48 tables and frequency sum verified. Independently recomputed Euler RHS [1,0,0,-15,25,-6,-10,5] and all 10 tables satisfy it; independently reimplemented Koszul Tor over QQ for witness {zww,yww,yzz,xzw,xyw} and matched census matrix exactly; verified witness index-to-name mapping, frequency sums, componentwise-maximal uniqueness of (b25,b35,b36,b46)=(9,15,13,3), constants b13=15/b24=25/b47=5, and socle distributions {5:24,6:468,7:1116,8:144} and full {5:52,...,11:36}. Lemma 1 (x^4 divisible among cubics only by x^3) is correct; Theorem 1 bijection and degree>=5 redundancy (all quartics in I) are correct; Koszul complex C_{i,j}=Lambda^i(k^4) x A_{j-i} with {0,+-1} matrices is mathematically equivalent to minimal free resolution, so dual-prime+rational+Euler+S4 evidence is a valid certificate for char 0/large primes despite no Macaulay2/Singular (explicitly disclosed). Minor exposition defect: Prop 3 conceptual sentence says standard monomials are closed under replacing by a smaller variable with descent to w^3; correct direction is ideals closed downward / standards closed upward to the maximal-variable cube (still a pure power in I), so the contradiction still holds and exhaustive scan 0/1752 carries the result independently. Characteristic limitation (no small-char check; monomial Betti numbers can depend on char) is disclosed and scoped.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Pardue (1996) proves lex ideals attain maximal Betti numbers for a given Hilbert function but gives only the single top table, and the lex ideal is not in the terminating H=(1,4,10,5) stratum (lex growth forces h4>0), so no census follows. Eliahou-Kervaire formulas cover only Borel-fixed/stable ideals; this stratum's stable subfamily is proved empty (exhaustively 0/1752, conceptually via pure-power forcing), so EK covers none of it. Boij-Soderberg theory is rational/cone-level and does not decide integral realizability at fixed H. Peeva-Stillman (2008/2009) explicitly lists the Hilbert-function vs Betti-table realizability gap as open; this closes one concrete colength-20 instance. Gorenstein locus work (e.g. H=(1,4,7,...,1)) is disjoint (socle type differs; only 24/1752 here have socle type 5). Triage query list (10 queries across Betti tables, lex-maximal, EK, BS, enumerations, polarization, Hilbert schemes, O-sequences) located no census for H=(1,4,10,5); fetched DOI records confirm the cited survey/maximality context. No prior identical list of 10 tables with frequencies/witnesses or 1752-count was found; grey-literature (thesis/code) overlap cannot be fully excluded and draft frames novelty as triage not priority claim.

value.rationale: Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Motivation: integral realizability at fixed Hilbert function is the open point left by Boij-Soderberg (rational) + Pardue/Bigatti-Hulett (maximal only) + EK (stable only), explicitly flagged by Peeva-Stillman; H=(1,4,10,5) is the quadric-free boundary (no generators in degree<=2 isolates cubic combinatorics), type-non-Gorenstein (socle mostly 6-8), finite and closable (C(16,5) space). Artifact is substantive and reusable: exact stratum size, 10 realized tables with frequencies summing to 1752, witness survivor set per table, full beta matrices, constants b13=15/b24=25/b47=5 with varying (b25,b35,b36,b46), unique lex-largest table, 80 S4-orbits with constancy, empty stable subfamily, socle-type distributions, and full degree<=4 extension (15504 ideals, 48 tables) beyond the fallback gap list. Single-command stdlib re-derivation in ~14s makes it independently worth finding later as a machine-checkable integral data point.
